description: Searches Google Images and returns up to 20 image results (title, original image URL, source page link, thumbnail and dimensions when available), with size, colour, type, aspect-ratio and licence filters. It does not download image files and does not return web pages (use google_search). Image rights stay with the source; the licence filter does not grant them. Required: query.

country.description: Two-letter search country code, e.g. "it"; default us. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

domain.description: Google search domain, e.g. "google.co.uk"; default google.com. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

image_color.description: Color filter such as bw, trans, red, blue or white, e.g. "bw"; omitted means any color. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

image_type.description: Image type: face, photo, clipart, lineart or animated, e.g. "photo"; omitted means any type. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

imgar.description: Aspect ratio: s (square), t (tall), w (wide), xw (panoramic), e.g. "w"; omitted means any. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

imgsz.description: Image size such as l, m, i, vga or 2mp, e.g. "l" for large; omitted means any size. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

language.description: Result language code, e.g. "it"; default en. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

licenses.description: License filter: f, fc, fm, fmc, cl or ol, e.g. "cl"; omitted means any license. Verify rights with the source before reuse. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

page.description: Zero-based results page, integer at least 0, e.g. 1 for the second page; default 0. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

query.description: Required Google Images search keywords, e.g. "espresso machine"; no default. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

safe.description: Adult-content filter: active or off, e.g. "active"; default off. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

tbs.description: Advanced Google Images filter expression copied from a search URL, e.g. "qdr:w" for the past week; omitted means no filter. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

name: google_images
title: Google Images
